description: Real-time stock levels across 5 warehouses: 3 Pakistan warehouses (Karachi Main Hub, Lahore Assembly Plant, Islamabad Central) and 2 China export hubs (Shanghai Export, Guangzhou Export). Tracks quantity on hand, reserved quantity, stock value in USD and PKR, turnover rates, and stock status.
common_use_cases: Check low stock or out-of-stock items in Pakistan warehouses
Calculate total inventory value in PKR
Analyze stock by warehouse location (Pakistan vs China)
Identify parts to transfer from China to Pakistan

columns.name: warehouse_location
columns.business_rule: Pakistan warehouses handle local distribution and assembly. China warehouses stage exports to Pakistan with 3-4 week lead times including customs clearance

columns.name: last_stock_check_date
columns.description: Date of last physical inventory count

columns.name: stock_value_usd
columns.description: Total value of inventory position in USD

columns.name: stock_value_pkr
columns.description: Total value of inventory position in PKR (for Pakistan CEO reporting)
columns.business_rule: PKR value calculated at ~280 PKR/USD rate. Total Pakistan warehouse inventory ~PKR 100+ billion

columns.name: days_of_supply
columns.description: Number of days current stock will last

relationships.description: Many inventory positions for one part

business_rules: Low Stock status triggers automatic reorder
Out of Stock requires urgent procurement action
Overstock suggests need for demand planning review
Safety stock levels vary by part criticality
Each part can have inventory in multiple warehouses
sample_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Inventory WHERE stock_status='Low Stock'
SELECT warehouse_location, SUM(stock_value_usd) FROM Inventory GROUP BY warehouse_location
SELECT part_id, SUM(quantity_on_hand) FROM Inventory GROUP BY part_id
SELECT * FROM Inventory WHERE stock_status='Overstock' ORDER BY stock_value_usd DESC
